BJP Chief Expresses Confidence in Uttar Pradesh Election Victory

Nitin Nabin, the BJP chief, has expressed confidence in the party's victory in Uttar Pradesh, stating that the energy and enthusiasm of workers indicate the 'lotus will bloom in the State again.' He made these remarks after concluding his first visit to west Uttar Pradesh since taking over as party head. Meanwhile, opposition MPs are reportedly engaging in one-upmanship regarding their ability to defeat the ruling party.
